title: Contraception as a decision: estrogen allowed or not, how effective it must be, hormones or none, and emergency contraception by days since unprotected intercourse; each method with its failure rate, when to choose it, when to avoid it and what to counsel
root: Contraception · sexually transmitted infection (STI) risk? add a condom to any method

legend.label: long-acting reversible contraception (LARC): implant + both intrauterine devices
no estrogen, so no ↑ clot risk
contains estrogen: check the contraindications in the estrogen question
acts on the progesterone receptor; not a progestin (ulipristal)

panels.title: Choosing a pill by complaint
items: absent or too-light flow → high estrogen, low progestin
acne or hirsutism → drospirenone (Yaz) or cyproterone (Diane-35); avoid levonorgestrel (Alesse)
sensitive to hormone swings → avoid triphasics
endometriosis → continuous or short break, low estrogen, high progestin

panels.title: Before stopping or switching
items: chose a less effective method → discuss emergency contraception now

groups.title: Emergency
groups.desc: After unprotected intercourse, as soon as possible. Acts before implantation, so useless once pregnant.

drugs.name: Copper intrauterine device (IUD)
drugs.moa: Toxic to sperm + oocyte; blocks implantation

lines.label: √ Choose when:
lines.text: days 1–7, any body mass index (BMI); wants ongoing contraception

lines.label: × Avoid:
lines.text: IUD contraindications (under column 2)

drugs.name: Ulipristal 30 mg × 1
drugs.agents: ≤ 5 days (120 h) · selective progesterone receptor modulator (SPRM)

lines.label: √ Choose when:
lines.text: days 3–5, or high BMI; more effective than levonorgestrel

lines.label: ▲ Watch:
lines.text: useless after the luteinizing hormone (LH) surge

drugs.name: Levonorgestrel 1.5 mg × 1
drugs.agents: Plan B · ≤ 72 h best, up to 5 days

lines.label: √ Choose when:
lines.text: within 72 h, normal BMI

lines.label: × Avoid:
lines.text: high BMI · LH rise already begun

drugs.name: Yuzpe
drugs.agents: ethinyl estradiol (EE) 100 mcg + LNG 500 mcg, 2 doses 12 h apart

lines.label: ▲ Watch:
lines.text: nausea from the high estrogen dose

ask.q: Unprotected sex in the last 7 days?

groups.title: Long-acting reversible (LARC)
groups.desc: Forgettable, 3–12 years. IUDs are fine with past pelvic inflammatory disease (PID), smoking, HIV, hepatitis C.

ask.q: Wants the MOST effective, or forgets pills?

drugs.name: Implant: Nexplanon (etonogestrel, a progestin)
drugs.moa: Blocks ovulation until year 3 · thickens cervical mucus

lines.label: √ Choose when:
lines.text: wants the MOST effective method; right after delivery or abortion

lines.label: ▲ Watch:
lines.text: irregular bleeding, acne, weight gain

drugs.name: Levonorgestrel intrauterine device (IUD)
drugs.moa: Mainly local: thick mucus barrier, thin endometrium · blocks ovulation in ≤ 40%

lines.label: √ Choose when:
lines.text: no estrogen + high pregnancy risk + poor adherence

lines.label: × Avoid:
lines.text: progestin-receptor-positive breast cancer

lines.label: ▲ Watch:
lines.text: insertion: perforation

drugs.name: Copper intrauterine device (IUD)
drugs.moa: Sterile inflammation: toxic to sperm + ovum; mucus unchanged

lines.label: √ Choose when:
lines.text: no hormones; light, regular periods; also emergency ≤ 7 d

lines.label: × Avoid:
lines.text: heavy or painful periods: ↑ blood loss + dysmenorrhea

after.label: × Avoid any IUD:
after.text: pregnancy · current PID or cervicitis · just after septic abortion · distorted cavity · unexplained bleeding · pelvic tuberculosis (TB)

groups.title: Barrier · natural · permanent
groups.desc: No hormones. Condoms are the backup for every method and the only STI protection.

lines.label: √ Choose when:
lines.text: STI risk; backup for any method

lines.label: × Avoid:
lines.text: nonoxynol-9 spermicide (↑ HIV) · lambskin (no HIV protection)

lines.label: ▲ Watch:
lines.text: use errors: on late, off early, no space at the tip

lines.label: √ Choose when:
lines.text: only option acceptable for cultural or religious reasons

lines.label: ▲ Watch:
lines.text: lactational amenorrhea works only with ALL 3: < 6 mo postpartum + fully breastfeeding + no menses

lines.label: √ Choose when:
lines.text: childbearing complete + monogamous: safer, more effective than tubal

lines.label: ▲ Watch:
lines.text: backup until semen analysis: azoospermia

lines.label: √ Choose when:
lines.text: childbearing complete

lines.label: × Avoid:
lines.text: young age: regret is the commonest complication

lines.label: ▲ Watch:
lines.text: hysteroscopic: backup ≥ 3 months

ask.q: Wants NO hormones, or done having children?
lines: copper IUD also has no hormones (column 2)

groups.title: Combined hormonal
groups.desc: Estrogen + progestin. Blocks ovulation every cycle. Estrogen ↓ nuisance bleeding.

drugs.name: Combined oral contraceptive pill (COC)
drugs.moa: Blocks ovulation EVERY cycle: ↓ gonadotropins, progestin blocks the LH surge

lines.label: √ Choose when:
lines.text: wants cycle control; acne, hirsutism, dysmenorrhea, premenstrual syndrome (PMS); ↓ endometrial + ovarian cancer

lines.label: × Avoid:
lines.text: the contraindications listed above · enzyme inducers: antiepileptics

lines.label: ▲ Watch:
lines.text: ↑ venous thromboembolism (VTE), still far less than pregnancy · nausea, breakthrough bleeding

drugs.name: Transdermal patch
drugs.moa: Same as the pill: blocks ovulation centrally · skips first-pass metabolism

lines.label: √ Choose when:
lines.text: same as the pill but can't manage a daily pill

lines.label: × Avoid:
lines.text: weight > 90 kg (less effective)

lines.label: ▲ Watch:
lines.text: skin irritation · ↑ VTE vs the pill

drugs.name: Vaginal ring
drugs.moa: Same as the pill: blocks ovulation centrally · best at stopping follicle growth

lines.label: √ Choose when:
lines.text: peri-rectal endometriosis; no daily pill

lines.label: ▲ Watch:
lines.text: vaginal discomfort · out ≤ 3 h a day

groups.title: Progestin-only
groups.desc: No estrogen, so no ↑ clot risk. The implant and levonorgestrel IUD are progestin-only too: see the LARC column.

drugs.name: Progestin-only pill
drugs.moa: Blocks ovulation in only 50% → relies on thick cervical mucus, ↓ sperm motility, ↓ tubal cilia

lines.label: √ Choose when:
lines.text: estrogen contraindicated: VTE risk, smoker > 35, postpartum

lines.label: × Avoid:
lines.text: poor adherence: > 3 h late needs backup

drugs.name: Injection: Depo-Provera, depot medroxyprogesterone acetate (DMPA)
drugs.moa: Blocks ovulation: ↓ pituitary gonadotropins → LOW-ESTROGEN state

lines.label: √ Choose when:
lines.text: wants amenorrhea; endometriosis, pelvic pain, seizures, sickle cell

lines.label: × Avoid:
lines.text: wants pregnancy soon (fertility returns late); worried about weight

lines.label: ▲ Watch:
lines.text: ↓ bone density, reversible, no fractures · weight gain ~7 lb in year 1
